name: Werner Brock
source:
"...You grew up in foster care, never knowing who your real parents were. You had to fight for everything in your life, with grit and steely determination.
You were involved in a murder a long time ago. The murder of one of your foster fathers. You were found not guilty by court's decision, ruling it as self-defense. Now a nosy cop called Magda is back to investigating it for some reason.
You have the ability to quickly heal, have high pain tolerance and it appears you can sprint over short distances with lightning speed.
You also know you cannot just love one woman or keep only one as a life partner. Instead, you prefer the company of many women."

[In-game description]
